# Observeri Technologies

> Observeri Technologies is a Dubai-based provider of AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software for enterprises, SMEs, and startups worldwide. Its platform connects cyber risk management, compliance, security governance, and threat exposure with financial risk intelligence, and covers the regulatory regimes those organisations work under.

Founded in 2025. Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Website: https://www.observeri.com. Contact: connect@observeri.com.

The platform serves enterprises, SMEs, and startups globally, including CISOs, CROs, heads of internal audit, and boards. Core topics include cyber risk quantification, predictive risk intelligence, external attack surface management, compliance automation, and third-party risk. Observeri covers the regulatory regimes those organisations work under.

Supported framework topics include SAMA, NESA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, DORA, MiCA, and the EU AI Act. Framework support describes product capabilities, not certification or endorsement by a regulator.

## Products

- [AI Risk Operations Center](https://www.observeri.com/products/ai-risk-operations-center): Unified intelligence connecting incidents, risks, vulnerabilities, threats, compliance, and asset risk scores.
- [Cyber Risk Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/cyber-risk-management): Live risk scoring, control mapping, FAIR-aligned quantification, and remediation prioritization.
- [Security Governance](https://www.observeri.com/products/security-governance): KRI/KPI monitoring, policy management, security budgeting, and change management.
- [Budget Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/budget-management): Every investment dollar is driven by a risk or a compliance obligation, so the board can compare the cost of impact with the cost of mitigation.
- [External Attack Surface Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/external-attack-surface-management): External asset discovery, shadow IT detection, attack paths, and cloud posture.
- [Information Asset Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/information-asset-management): Asset inventory, AI risk scores, control effectiveness, and exposure visibility.
- [Data Privacy & Protection](https://www.observeri.com/products/data-privacy-protection): PII detection, sensitive data discovery, secret scanning, and exposure scoring.
- [Data Loss Prevention](https://www.observeri.com/products/data-loss-prevention): Approved email, cloud drive, and AI channels, shadow-medium detection, and violations opened as risk incidents.
- [Third-Party Risk Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/third-party-risk): Vendor discovery, risk prioritization, evidence collection, and remediation.
- [Vulnerability Operations](https://www.observeri.com/products/vulnerability-operations): Vulnerability ingestion, exploitability prioritization, SLA tracking, and remediation programs.
- [Exposure Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/exposure-management): Assessment planning, attack surface monitoring, issue tracking, and remediation workflows.
- [Compliance Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/compliance-management): Regulations library, AI compliance registers, self-assessments, submissions, and policy gap analysis.
- [Centralised Controls Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/centralised-controls-management): A library of 3,000+ controls, applicability, testing with evidence, and effectiveness that updates mapped risk, compliance, and incidents.
- [Automated Compliance](https://www.observeri.com/products/automated-compliance): On-prem agent for Windows and Linux, virtual connector for Azure, GCP, AWS, and Oracle Cloud, scheduled posture checks, and a real-time risk view.
- [Business Continuity Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/business-continuity-management): BIA register, DR and BCP plans tied to it, a crisis war room, and simulated BCP and DR exercises.
- [Human Risk Management](https://www.observeri.com/products/human-risk-management): Privileged identity monitoring, Human Risk Exposure scoring, and financial exposure analysis.
